mechanics_summary: 100–300-Ki Ki Blast Super. The base beam deals a documented 10% over 10 hits; holding the input spends 200 additional Ki and adds 18 hits for another 10%. When the user is at critical/red health, the beam can extend to 47 hits (48 at very close range) for a documented 30% total and the held Ki drain is reduced, while the total Ki cost remains in the same 100–300 range. Exact current frame and scaling behavior remain unresolved.
